project_info.theme: Galaxy S21 cinematic camera hero poster

main_subject.detail: Minimal smartphone hero poster showing the front and back of a lavender Galaxy S21-like device overlapped together, with copy about absolute cinema placed across the rear panel.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic clean Samsung product render, minimalist premium camera-phone advertising

composition_elements.text: This is who you asked for / Absolute cinema
items: Top Left: Clean white background with no extra graphical clutter.
Top Right: Front-facing phone with centered punch-hole display and pink-blue abstract wallpaper.
Bottom Left: Rear lavender phone with rose-gold camera island and three vertically stacked lenses.
Bottom Right: Empty white negative space around the device duo.
Center/Background: Overlapping front and back phone composition with the copy 'This is who you asked for Absolute cinema' centered on the rear panel.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle metallic reflections, clean edge definition, premium minimal contrast

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy S21 cinematic camera hero poster. Centerpiece is a minimal overlapped front-and-back lavender Samsung smartphone composition on a white background, with a rose-gold camera island and a front display showing a pink-blue abstract wallpaper. Background is clean and bright. Surrounding elements: exact copy 'This is who you asked for Absolute cinema' centered over the rear phone body. Technical style: photorealistic product render, soft studio lighting, gentle metallic reflections and clean edge definition, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
